review.scope: Two serial initial curation/support-diff reviews and bounded confirmations in the same original sessions. All selected readings and full source lists remained unchanged during corrections.

policy: Preserve every source reading and its order. Explicit quiz subsets prioritize useful recognition anchored in the inspected lexical families, not every dictionary-listed pronunciation. An excluded reading is not declared invalid or necessarily rare. All selected readings have their own linked table row. No nanori or frequency ranking is inferred.

limits: Two-family textual curation/support review and bounded correction confirmations are complete; original teaching reports remain preserved. Returned-byte receipts are not proof of comprehension or native-speaker certification. Complete-archive curated-pilot native acceptance and publication remain outstanding. Physical-phone/general-release acceptance is explicitly outstanding, not a new veto on bounded owner-testing publication. Compatible APK is required; old clients ignore curation.
